events.text: Someone at the market keeps looking your way and smiling.

effects.log: A small warmth that lasts all day.
You think about it all night.

events.text: You receive a love letter meant for someone else.

choices.text: Deliver it to the right person

effects.log: Two people are very happy.

choices.text: Keep it as an example of how to write one

effects.log: It is beautiful.

events.text: A matchmaker arranges a meeting. You both sit in awkward silence.

effects.log: The ice breaks. A good afternoon.
They are bored. You are not.

events.text: At the harvest festival, everyone dances around the fire.

effects.log: A fine dance. You never learn their name.
Your feet tap on their own.

events.text: Someone you liked is marrying someone else.

effects.log: It hurts, and it heals.
You forget eventually. You are much stronger.

events.text: Your poem about love is read aloud at a gathering, without your name.

effects.log: Everyone wonders who wrote it.
Three admirers by evening.

events.text: A stranger offers to share their umbrella in a sudden rain.

effects.log: A long walk. A good talk.
Wet but proud.

events.text: Flowers appear at your door every week. Nobody admits to sending them.

choices.text: Wait up one night to see

effects.log: You fall asleep. Flowers again.
The next week, the flowers come with a note: "You are welcome."

events.text: Your eyes meet a stranger's across a teahouse.

choices.text: Send over a cup of tea

effects.log: They raise the cup to you.

choices.text: Leave before you do something foolish

effects.log: Wise, maybe.

events.text: Rumours say you kissed someone at the festival. You did not.

effects.log: Nobody believes you.
Everyone laughs.
